title: Skulto Onboarding Hub
description: A seven-part onboarding course for Skulto — the cross-platform AI-skills manager that scans for prompt injection before you install. Every fact verified against source.

routes.title: 1 · Overview & Mental Model
routes.summary: What Skulto is, the two problems it solves (prompt-injection risk + 33-tool fragmentation), and the one idea behind the codebase: three interfaces over one shared service layer. Includes the repo tour and a where-to-change map.

routes.title: 2 · Build & First Run
routes.summary: Clone, make deps, build both binaries, and walk the five-step first-run onboarding. Demystifies the ~/.agents/skulto data directory and every environment variable.

routes.title: 3 · The CLI
routes.summary: The golden-path workflow (add → install → check), the complete command reference (including the often-missed list, discover, and ingest), and how save/sync make a project's skills reproducible via skulto.json.

routes.title: 4 · The TUI
routes.summary: The default front door: its views, the real per-view keybindings (not the misleading keys.go keymap), and the core flows — search, install with the platform/scope dialog, manage/uninstall, and favorites.

routes.title: 5 · The MCP Server
routes.summary: Wire Skulto into an AI agent over stdio: the full 12-tool surface, the two skill resources, a real client config, the install selection handshake, and proof it's a thin adapter over the same services as CLI/TUI.

routes.title: 6 · Security Scanner
routes.summary: The corrected, code-grounded model: 9 categories (not 4), per-pattern severity, score = base minus context mitigation, the warning threshold, and the truth about scan-before-install (implemented but non-blocking today).

routes.title: 7 · Data, Search & Contributing
routes.summary: How storage (SQLite/GORM/FTS5/BM25) and hybrid search work, the OPENAI_API_KEY gating chain, the telemetry four-step rule, the CI gates, and a worked first change framed around capability-vs-presentation.
